related.title: Kubernetes API Priority and Fairness：座位預算與請求成本
related.titleEn: Kubernetes API Priority and Fairness: seat budgets and request cost
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付pod-requests.csv、quota-decision.json、effective-defaults.json與scheduling-unknowns.md；保留requests、limits、usage三欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver pod-requests.csv, quota-decision.json, effective-defaults.json and scheduling-unknowns.md. Keep requests, limits and usage in separate columns so the receiving operator can reproduce the admission decision without reinterpretation.
related.difference: 用合成座位預算比較兩個優先等級，保留請求成本與占用時間；建立明確簡化模型，不宣稱重現Kubernetes完整排程演算法。
related.differenceEn: Compare two priority levels using a synthetic seat budget, preserving request cost and occupancy duration. State the simplified model explicitly rather than claiming to reproduce the complete Kubernetes scheduling algorithm.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: ResourceQuota限制命名空間累計宣告資源與物件；配額允許不等於Pod一定能排程，且配額不是資料存取授權或機密隔離。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 配額requests.cpu為8核心，現有10個Pod各要求0.6核心，合計6；新Pod要求2.5，觀測CPU只有2核心但不參與額度相加。 新總請求8.5核心，超額0.5，所以本例拒絕；若新要求改2核心，總數8剛好符合該配額。

APF以流程及優先等級管理API併發與公平性；本例固定無借用、總60座位、權重2比1，僅用比例計算名義分配。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 等級A權重2分40座位，B權重1分20；A每請求占4座位，B每請求占1，所有工作期間相同且無其他限制。 A同時可放40/4=10請求，B可放20/1=20；A座位較多仍可同時服務較少請求。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: ResourceQuota constrains aggregate declared resources and objects in a namespace. Passing quota admission does not guarantee schedulability, and quota is neither data-access authorization nor a confidentiality boundary. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The requests.cpu quota is eight cores. Ten existing Pods each request 0.6, totaling six; a new Pod requests 2.5. Observed use is only two cores but is excluded from quota arithmetic. The proposed total is 8.5 cores, exceeding quota by 0.5, so this fixture rejects admission. Reducing the new request to two cores produces a total of eight, satisfying that quota.

APF manages API concurrency through flows and priority levels. The fixture fixes sixty seats, disables borrowing and assumes a two-to-one share ratio solely to calculate an illustrative nominal allocation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Level A receives forty seats from weight two, while B receives twenty from weight one. Each A request consumes four seats and each B request one; durations are equal with no additional constraints. A can admit 40/4=10 simultaneous requests, whereas B can admit 20/1=20. More seats therefore need not mean a larger count of concurrent requests when costs differ.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google SRE：多層重試的組合放大與單層預算
related.titleEn: Google SRE: combinatorial retry amplification and single-layer budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付pod-requests.csv、quota-decision.json、effective-defaults.json與scheduling-unknowns.md；保留requests、limits、usage三欄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver pod-requests.csv, quota-decision.json, effective-defaults.json and scheduling-unknowns.md. Keep requests, limits and usage in separate columns so the receiving operator can reproduce the admission decision without reinterpretation.
related.difference: 明確定義attempt包含第一次、retry不包含第一次；比較每層最多三次attempt與僅最靠近故障層重試的最壞呼叫數。
related.differenceEn: Define attempt to include the initial call and retry to exclude it. Compare a maximum of three attempts at every layer with retries confined to the layer directly above the failure.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: ResourceQuota限制命名空間累計宣告資源與物件；配額允許不等於Pod一定能排程，且配額不是資料存取授權或機密隔離。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 配額requests.cpu為8核心，現有10個Pod各要求0.6核心，合計6；新Pod要求2.5，觀測CPU只有2核心但不參與額度相加。 新總請求8.5核心，超額0.5，所以本例拒絕；若新要求改2核心，總數8剛好符合該配額。

SRE過載處理討論分層重試放大及預算；本例假設每次都失敗、同步串列且沒有快取，計算最壞嘗試次數而非預期成功率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 三個重試層A,B,C，每層一次上游呼叫最多發出3個下游attempt。單一root_id貫穿所有合成記錄，attempt_id不可重用。 多層重試最底層3×3×3=27次；僅C最多三次、A/B各一次，最底層只有3次，降低24次。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: ResourceQuota constrains aggregate declared resources and objects in a namespace. Passing quota admission does not guarantee schedulability, and quota is neither data-access authorization nor a confidentiality boundary. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The requests.cpu quota is eight cores. Ten existing Pods each request 0.6, totaling six; a new Pod requests 2.5. Observed use is only two cores but is excluded from quota arithmetic. The proposed total is 8.5 cores, exceeding quota by 0.5, so this fixture rejects admission. Reducing the new request to two cores produces a total of eight, satisfying that quota.

SRE overload guidance addresses layered retry amplification and budgets. This fixture assumes every attempt fails, execution is synchronous and serial, and no cache intervenes; it counts worst-case attempts, not expected success probability. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Retry layers A, B and C each issue at most three downstream attempts for one upstream call. A single root_id links the synthetic trace, while every attempt_id remains distinct. Layered retries generate 3×3×3=27 leaf attempts. With only C allowed three attempts and A/B each allowed one, the leaf receives three attempts, a reduction of twenty-four.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
